questions.q: Reverse-Flash (Eobard Thawne) is the arch-enemy of which Flash?
questions.why: Thawne is defined by his obsession with Barry Allen, the Silver Age and modern Flash.

questions.q: Which actor played Eobard Thawne disguised as Harrison Wells in TV's The Flash?
questions.why: Tom Cavanagh played the hidden villain in the Arrowverse series The Flash.

questions.q: By what villain alias is Eobard Thawne also known?
questions.why: Thawne debuted under the name Professor Zoom, and the name stuck as an alias.

questions.q: Which two creators introduced Eobard Thawne's Reverse-Flash?
questions.why: John Broome and Carmine Infantino created the Reverse-Flash for The Flash #139.

questions.q: In which year did Reverse-Flash debut in The Flash #139?
questions.why: He first appeared in The Flash #139, dated September 1963.

questions.q: In post-Crisis comics, from which century does Eobard Thawne come?
questions.why: After Crisis he is a 25th-century scientist who idolises Barry Allen.

questions.q: In which year was the Reverse-Flash first named Eobard Thawne, in The Flash #153?
questions.why: His debut was in 1963, but the full name came two years later in The Flash #153.

questions.q: In modern comics, what is the first name of the Flash's mother, killed by Thawne to ruin her son's life?
questions.why: Thawne murders Nora Allen as part of his campaign to wreck Barry's childhood.

questions.q: Who played Eobard Thawne in his own likeness in the TV series The Flash?
questions.why: Matt Letscher played Thawne without the Harrison Wells disguise.

questions.q: In the Flashpoint story, which hero kills Eobard Thawne?
questions.why: In the Flashpoint timeline, Thomas Wayne's Batman ends Thawne's life.
